query:
SELECT
            er.user_id as "user_id?",
            er.guest_name as "guest_name?",
            u.first_name as "first_name?",
            u.infix as "infix?",
            u.last_name as "last_name?"
        FROM event_registration er
            LEFT JOIN "user" u ON er.user_id = u.id
        WHERE er.event_id = $1
          AND er.waiting_list_position IS NULL
